narration: Channels connect MIRA to wherever your techs already work.

Over Telegram, field techs send photos, voice notes, and diagnostic questions straight to MIRA. Slack and Microsoft Teams push alerts, work-order updates, and requests to the whole team. WhatsApp is on the way.
CMMS connectors sync work orders, assets, and parts both ways — MaintainX, and Atlas CMMS already live and syncing in real time, with Limble and UpKeep coming soon.
And document sources — Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Dropbox — feed your manuals and schematics straight into MIRA's knowledge base.
